name: Create a new app
description: Create a new app Creates a new Cloudflare calls app. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/calls/apps
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/calls/apps
Creates a new Cloudflare calls app. An app is an unique enviroment where each Session can access all Tracks within the app.
Required: account_id (path); body (body)

name: Delete app
description: Delete app Deletes an app from Cloudflare Calls DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/calls/apps/{app_id}

name: List apps
description: List apps Lists all apps in the Cloudflare account GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/calls/apps
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/calls/apps
Lists all apps in the Cloudflare account
Required: account_id (path)

name: Retrieve app details
description: Retrieve app details Fetches details for a single Calls app. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/calls/apps/{app_id}

name: Edit app details
description: Edit app details Edit details for a single app. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/calls/apps/{app_id}

name: Delete TURN key
description: Delete TURN key Deletes a TURN key from Cloudflare Calls DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/calls/turn_keys/{key_id}

name: Retrieve TURN key details
description: Retrieve TURN key details Fetches details for a single TURN key. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/calls/turn_keys/{key_id}

name: Create a new TURN key
description: Create a new TURN key Creates a new Cloudflare Calls TURN key. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/calls/turn_keys
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/calls/turn_keys
Creates a new Cloudflare Calls TURN key.
Required: account_id (path); body (body)

name: List TURN Keys
description: List TURN Keys Lists all TURN keys in the Cloudflare account GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/calls/turn_keys

Required: account_id (path)
